status: Owner-authorized prospective website delivery simplification: custom marketing websites, one initial launch and source-code handoff. Current prices and page caps retained. No measured margin or demand claim. Provider fit, actual fees and capacity are confirmed before acceptance. Previously accepted agreements retain their exact original terms.

focused_site.type: Fixed price for the exact listed scope. The signed quote identifies pages and deliverables. Any extra is separately priced before signing or through a written change request.
focused_site.included_pages: Up to 7 marketing pages, such as Home, About, Services, Projects, FAQs and Contact, chosen around what your customers need to know. The agreed page map names each page and its purpose.
focused_site.page_scope: Up to 7 agreed marketing pages. Marketing pages are the pages that introduce your business, explain your services and help visitors take the next step. Examples include Home, About, Services, individual service pages, Projects, FAQs and Contact. Each page has its own web address; several sections on one page still count as one page. An agreed article page also counts toward the limit. Supplied plain policy pages are separate. We agree the page list before booking; additional pages receive a separate quote.
focused_site.copy: Complete useful website copy for the agreed pages and buyer questions, written and edited from client-approved facts. Content depth follows the job, with no word-count ceiling or padding. Original field research, legal drafting and unsupported claims are outside scope.
focused_site.seo_foundation: Business discovery and a keyword-to-page intent map; complete useful copy from approved facts; titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, canonical/crawl/sitemap checks and factual structured data where appropriate. Analytics and Search Console connection with approved access and reviewed privacy. No ranking or traffic guarantee.
focused_site.creative: Developed art direction and purposeful interface animation across deeper service journeys. Three custom launch graphics, six supplied-photo edits, a practical brand sheet, cleaned existing-logo exports, favicon/social avatar and three editable promotional templates are included. Lightweight mobile and reduced-motion treatment is included. Full identity redesign and a custom animated hero or 3D centerpiece are separate. One browser-tab icon and one default branded social link-sharing image from approved assets are included, with page metadata checks; additional variants are separate.
focused_site.functionality: Two distinct contact forms, each with up to six agreed fields, one receiving destination and one confirmation state; basic spam defense and save/notification/confirmation checks. Forms collect ordinary business inquiries. Sensitive personal information and file uploads require a separate assessment. Up to 2 agreed links or compatible standard embeds for client-ready booking or newsletter services. External account configuration and automation are separate. Your custom website comes with editable source and content files. You or your chosen developer can update the code, check the changes and publish them. We confirm the technology, compatible hosting and who will handle future updates before booking.
focused_site.revisions: Two combined feedback rounds across the approved website: one design review and one staging review. In-scope defects are corrected separately. A new direction, extra page or feature requires an agreed change quote.
focused_site.handoff: Within five business days of paid completion or reconciled termination, receive the existing paid website source, approved content/assets, dependency and non-secret configuration files, a start-here guide, build/publishing instructions, license/account map, dated checks and known unfinished items in a delivery folder or ZIP. Generated hosting files are included where applicable. Connected services and credentials require their separate account setup or secure transfer; a ZIP does not migrate them automatically. This handoff is separate from the 30-day defect-correction window. Client-controlled accounts remain accessible throughout.
focused_site.correction: 30 calendar days after launch for defects against accepted scope. New requests and external-provider changes are separate. Paid handoff is not withheld until this period ends.
focused_site.delivery_target: Typical website projects use 7–10 working days of production after the agreed start and ready content, access and business facts, plus the agreed client review windows. Larger scopes, extra features or delayed feedback can take longer; your written scope confirms the production, review and launch dates. Dates also depend on selected-tool feasibility and actual capacity. The quote reserves launch checks, source handoff and defect-correction capacity; this is a planning estimate, not a guaranteed turnaround time.
focused_site.policy_page: Supplied plain policy pages are included beyond the marketing-page cap. Client-approved text only; legal drafting is separate.
focused_site.redirect_limit: Up to 10 simple one-to-one redirects from an existing supplied URL inventory. Migration discovery, large migrations and redirect chains require separate scope.

focused_site.platform_fit: Your custom website comes with editable source and content files. You or your chosen developer can update the code, check the changes and publish them. We confirm the technology, compatible hosting and who will handle future updates before booking.

If a standard embed is unsuitable, agree a link or a separate scope before booking.

ownership_and_billing.late_payment: Pause new unpaid work after notice; preserve client-owned assets and access. No disabling a paid client-owned website to enforce an unrelated service invoice.
ownership_and_billing.build_cancellation: On cancellation, you receive a dated ledger of completed work, approved committed costs and payments for reconciliation under the signed agreement. billing_illustration.actual_quote_rule: Provider costs, taxes, setup and invoice counts must be stated for the actual period.

monthly_terms.small_batch: One related batch of supplied text, image or link updates in existing components, such as correcting hours and contact details together. It is not unrelated changes across the entire site.
monthly_terms.priority: Choose one defined priority from page/CMS/known-workflow improvement, useful article, eligible profile batch, promotional graphic or newsletter campaign draft/setup. Each is one alternative use of an included priority, with an agreed affected area, outcome, completion test, one refinement and QA. It is not an additional allowance or unlimited development. Email is never sent without the client’s explicit approval.
monthly_terms.queue: One work queue per site. Small-change batches and priorities are distinct included units; the same change does not fulfill two units. Audit findings use these allowances when accepted as the priority. Defects caused by our own work are corrected without using a paid allowance.
monthly_terms.cadence: The initial baseline records every dimension with evidence and access limits. Monthly checks cover the main contact path, available indexing/performance warnings, and routine CMS/forms/known-workflow health, including appropriate access checks. Quarterly review revisits all review statuses and changed evidence; it is not exhaustive specialist investigation. New application features or business-logic changes require separately agreed scope.
monthly_terms.hosting: You own and pay for hosting, your domain and paid tools directly. Our fee covers the agreed setup and work. Monthly studio service is optional. Before booking, itemize the services your website needs. Name the actual plan, currency/taxes, billing term, renewal, seats, usage limits, overages, support and export/recovery owner. Required costs are confirmed before enrollment.
monthly_terms.response: Automated monitoring is not continuous human staffing. Review, contact and work windows are agreed before enrollment around actual availability. There is no 24/7 service or guaranteed restoration deadline; urgent issues are classified, communicated and routed within the agreed coverage.
monthly_terms.renewal: Monthly billing is in advance with no minimum term: the quote states the exact renewal timestamp/timezone and cancellation route; cancel before renewal to stop future invoices. Annual prepayment instead ends after twelve cycles and renews only after written confirmation. Five business days before each cycle, confirm useful work and ready inputs for paid improvement units; if none is agreed, pause the next monthly invoice or reconcile the unused prepaid annual cycle. Charges without approved useful work receive an unused-work refund or credit, with begun work itemized and unearned amounts reconciled.
monthly_terms.rollover: Unused capacity does not roll over. Accepted work delayed by Wonder & Method remains owed; it does not expire with the month. Missing client inputs receive notice and a revised available slot.
monthly_terms.exit: Paid bespoke source/content and client-owned accounts remain yours, subject to disclosed provider license/export limits. Direct vendor subscriptions continue or cancel according to your instructions. Unfinished accepted work remains owed. Routine paid-file handoff is included; new migration work is quoted separately. An unrelated service invoice cannot justify disabling paid client work.

annual_terms.payment: Pay the full twelve-cycle price in advance. The monthly equivalent is a comparison, not a monthly charge. The same monthly units and sequence apply; annual billing does not accelerate twelve months of work into one. annual_terms.renewal: The annual term ends after twelve cycles. A reminder is sent 30 days before the end; another annual payment requires written confirmation. There is no automatic annual charge. The paid term price does not change retroactively. Without a new agreement, service ends at expiry and paid deliverables and client accounts remain yours.
annual_terms.cancellation: Cancel effective at the end of the current service cycle. Refund each future whole unused cycle at the discounted monthly equivalent, based on completed cycles at the effective service end. Before service starts, refund the full annual service payment. No cancellation penalty, retained processing fee, discount clawback or repricing of completed cycles applies. Separately itemize any current-cycle unearned work caused by studio failure or a charge without approved useful work. Accepted work delayed by us remains owed; agree any substitute or refund explicitly.
annual_terms.hosting: Vendor bills are paid directly and are separate from annual studio service. Vendor cancellation and refunds follow each vendor’s contract; no provider refund is promised by the studio.
annual_terms.overlap: Annual service covers agreed care and additional work. The same work, defect correction or usable baseline is never charged twice.
annual_terms.refund_example: After four completed service cycles, eight future whole cycles are refundable at the discounted rate. Any current-cycle or delayed-work reconciliation is separate.
annual_terms.refund_timing: Initiate the agreed refund within ten business days of the effective service end, or cancellation confirmation before service starts, and provide an itemized settlement. Return undisputed unearned money within that deadline even if other work or amounts remain disputed. Bank or processor posting time is separate.
annual_terms.build_rights: Canceling annual care preserves your ownership, client account access and any unfinished work owed under your accepted project agreement.
